a.title: spring break
a.hook: you and {partner} planned the road trip for months. tonight your mom said no.
openingLines: the car is packed for friday.
a.setting: A small town in North Carolina, the week before spring break, junior year of college. You're home for the weekend.
a.tone: bittersweet and funny: growing up, one argument at a time

self.description: Twenty, the responsible one, and tired of being treated like you're twelve.
self.want: To go on the trip without blowing up your family.

cast.name: {partner}
cast.relationshipType: your best friend since middle school
cast.description: The co-planner, who already booked the beach house on their card.
cast.want: The trip they've been promising themselves all year.
cast.avoids: Losing the money, or losing you to it.
cast.closeness: you've been each other's person since seventh grade
cast.tension: they've covered for your family before and they're tired of it

cast.name: Mom

cast.voiceTone: short texts, then a long one

opening.title: The plan

opening.title: The no

background: Your mom has been reading about car accidents since your cousin's.
